subject: PO issuance, spend window and line-item remap for BlueStreak Labs
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@bluestreaklabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@bluestreaklabs.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: PO issuance and provisional spend window for onboarding

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. We're ready to move the onboarding forward and need a provisional PO number and spend window so our finance team can schedule the first invoices. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the initial SOW (BSL_Onboarding_Form.pdf).

Key ask: can Redwood issue a provisional PO that covers the onboarding onboarding services for Nov–Jan with a monthly spend cap of $35,000? We'll split the SOW across three line items (integration, testing, first-month consumption) but can provide a CSV export if you prefer.

What we need from you to proceed:
- A PO number (or temporary reference) that we can include on invoices
- Confirmation of the monthly spend cap and whether Redwood requires any special ledger codes on invoices
- Any vendor attestation / compliance forms we still need to submit

We'd like to start invoicing for onboarding professional services as soon as the PO is in place. Can you confirm timeline?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance, BlueStreak Labs
elena@bluestreaklabs.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: BSL_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@bluestreaklabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: PO issuance and provisional spend window for onboarding

Hi Elena —

Thanks for sending the form. I pulled this into the onboarding queue and looped in Ben and Priyom to help with PO issuance and accounting mapping. A few clarifying items before we create a provisional PO:

- Can you confirm the exact monthly cap to be applied to the three line items (integration, testing, consumption)? You mentioned $35,000 monthly total — we need the per-line-item split for ledger mapping.
- Do you have a preferred invoice remit address and AP contact (we need name + email + PO reference on file)?
- For our internal controls, procurement requires either: vendor attestation (signed) OR completion of the vendor security questionnaire. If you can return the attestation we can fast-track.

Our standard process for provisional PO issuance is: create a temporary PO reference for onboarding (marked PROV), open a spend guard at the requested monthly cap, and then convert to a full PO once Compliance signs off. We can issue a provisional reference within 48 business hours of getting the per-line split and AP contact.

I've attached the Vendor Onboard Checklist we use (vendor_onboard_checklist.pdf) to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Proposed next steps:
1) You send per-line-item amounts and AP contact (today)
2) We issue a provisional PO reference and share the provisional PO PDF
3) You submit attestation or the completed security questionnaire
4) We finalize the PO and lift the provisional spend guard

Ben / Priyom — FYI on ledger code requirements: can procurement advise whether we should apply ledger code 42-OPS or 54-PROD for the integration SLAs?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: vendor_onboard_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Marissa —

Appreciate the quick reply. Attached is an exported CSV with the line-item split for the three SOW buckets: integration $12,000/mo, testing $8,000/mo, consumption $15,000/mo (Updated_SOW_lineitems.csv). AP contact is: Dana Morales (dana.morales@bluestreaklabs.com). Remit address is BlueStreak Labs, 2248 Harbor Drive, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401.

We will also attach the signed vendor attestation later today. We need the provisional PO reference to be included on the first two onboarding invoices (expected this week). If there are any required ledger codes for Redwood's AP, please advise and we'll include them on the invoice lines.

Thanks,
Elena

Subject: Re: Request: PO issuance and provisional spend window for onboarding

Elena —

Thanks for the split and the AP contact. We issued a provisional PO reference this morning: 2026-PO-8342 (attached provisional PDF). The procurement ledger mapping is as follows: integration -> 42-OPS, testing -> 42-OPS, consumption -> 54-PROD. We've opened a spend window of $35,000/mo under the provisional PO and applied the per-line caps you provided.

Please note: the provisional PO allows invoicing up to the monthly cap but is subject to conversion to a full PO once Compliance receives the signed vendor attestation (you mentioned you'd send it today). If your first invoice hits the provisional cap and compliance is pending, we'll still accept invoices but payment terms will follow standard onboarding timelines until full PO conversion.

Action items for BlueStreak:
- Submit signed attestation (or complete questionnaire) and reply to PROC-1729 (internal ticket)
- When invoicing, include 2026-PO-8342 and the line-level descriptions exactly as in the CSV
- For any invoice queries, route to dana.morales@bluestreaklabs.com and cc finance@bluestreaklabs.com

I've attached the provisional PO stub (2026-PO-8342.pdf). Once Compliance confirms, we'll update the PO to final and remove the PROV tag. If you need any edits to the line descriptions for matching, reply and we'll adjust the PO lines so your AP can reconcile cleanly.

Ben Carter
Head of Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: 2026-PO-8342.pdf (application/pdf)
